dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.core.flags.isabstract-to-jdtflags.isabstract>
<!description: Replace org.eclipse.jdt.core.Flags.isAbstract with org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.util.JdtFlags.isAbstract for IMember. This migration accounts for Java 8+ abstract method semantics in interfaces, ensuring accurate abstract status determination for members.>
<!severity: WARNING>
org.eclipse.jdt.core.Flags.isAbstract($member.getFlags()) :: instanceof($member, "org.eclipse.jdt.core.IMember")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.corext.util.JdtFlags.isAbstract($member)
;;
